crossRefs.note: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and…
Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

translations.web: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
translations.bsb: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
translations.kjv: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
translations.asv: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.
